research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: SCUBA Analytics is researching systems and methods for rapid data analysis and methods for enhancing rapid data analysis that interpret queries on sharded datasets, collect representative samples, and compute approximate results quickly. They also develop methods for stratified sampling based query execution that identify stratum classifiers from initial samples to support efficient, privacy conscious, in the moment decision intelligence and activation across these areas of research and development.

overview_description.description: SCUBA is a collaborative decision intelligence platform providing in-the-moment decision intelligence and activation without compromising privacy. Global brands like Microsoft, McDonald's, Twitter, and Warner Bros trust SCUBA to gain in-the-moment insights across billions of touchpoints, fueling real-time experiences and growth. Founded by former Facebook executives and led by industry veterans from Kantar, Sonos, Splunk, and WarnerMedia.

about_short_description.short_description: Collaborative Decision Intelligence Platform providing in-the-moment decision intelligence and activation without compromising privacy.

product.name: Collaborative Decision Intelligence Platform
product.description: A platform that provides real-time data insights, measurement, and activation while maintaining data privacy.

product.name: Data Collaboration Rooms (1P, 2P, 3P)
product.description: Virtual environments for secure, privacy-compliant data sharing and analysis across first, second, and third-party data sources.

product.name: Dynamic Audience Segmentation and Activation
product.description: A solution for creating and activating predictive and dynamic audience segments in real-time to optimize marketing campaigns.

product.name: Real-Time Campaign Measurement and Attribution
product.description: Tools for immediate cross-channel campaign impact measurement and attribution to optimize marketing spend and outcomes.

product.name: Insights Marketplace
product.description: A collaborative ecosystem providing access to trillions of audience data points and prebuilt insights from leading data providers.

product.name: Secure IDMatch and Privacy-Enhancing Technologies
product.description: Technologies that enable secure, anonymized identity matching and data protection across multiple parties and environments.
